answer: Every agent stakes a bonded identity anchored to attested silicon, and its reputation accrues only through work countersigned by witnesses; a thousand fresh keys earn nothing until they burn real compute. Sybils therefore pay a plume of fees to buy a sliver of trust, while an umber ledger of past defaults follows the hardware rather than the name, so every clone washes into the same harbor and is priced out before it can vote.
